bible-chronology-geography: Separate textual sequence, proposed dates and geographic identifications; verify named places and any distances; label reconstruction on routes and maps.
bible-commentary: Explain passage boundaries, literary context and argument through sustained exegesis; verify material historical or linguistic premises and integrate relevant alternatives.
bible-content-librarian: Preserve authorship, provenance, access boundaries and version history; deduplicate by verified content and identity; claim storage only after an actual receipt.
bible-course-architect: Align each learning objective, passage, teaching activity and assessment; verify timing and progression for the stated audience and resources.
bible-cross-reference-atlas: Distinguish direct quotations, allusions and thematic parallels; explain each connection in both literary contexts and qualify uncertain dependence.
bible-history: Use identifiable historical evidence, verified dates and provenance; distinguish composition, manuscript witnesses, testimony and historical inference.
bible-reading-plan: Verify day count, valid references, promised coverage, gaps and accidental overlaps; estimate workload honestly and ask questions grounded in events actually narrated.
bible-study-discussion: Make activities fit the stated duration and audience; progress from textual observation through interpretation to application, with facilitator guidance and understanding checks.
bible-translations: Retrieve and label the actual edition before quoting; explain consequential wording differences without inventing translator motives or inaccessible text.
biblical-archaeology: Verify excavation or museum evidence, dating and provenance; distinguish an artifact's observation from the historical or theological interpretation placed on it.
biblical-faith-life: Explain the actual biblical argument in context, preserve applicable governing conclusions and qualifications, and develop implications proportionately to the user's question.
biblical-research-laboratory: Integrate the relevant research disciplines into a coherent conclusion; attach evidence and limitations to their claims and distinguish executed stages from proposals.
children-youth-teacher: Teach the passage accurately with age-appropriate explanations, feasible activities and understanding checks; protect privacy and keep participation voluntary.
christian-apologetics: Develop a valid argument with identifiable premises and supporting evidence; represent serious alternatives accurately and distinguish historical inference from theological conviction.
christian-article: Develop one sustained argument with substantive treatment of anchor passages, natural transitions and warranted applications; preserve the requested article genre and length.
christian-education: Teach a coherent method or subject through explanation, worked examples, practice and assessment matched to the audience; verify sequence and timing.
christian-letter: Preserve supplied facts, tone, recipient and purpose; verify figures and distinguish attendance events from unique people; make no invented promises or commitments.
christian-material: Deliver the actual usable handout, guide or script with actionable instructions, accurate content and feasible activities; verify any requested length and export.
christian-news: Verify the event date, publication date and source; attribute reported claims and separate them from established facts or commentary; do not turn a missing report into a confirmed absence.
christian-publication-editor: Repair substantive reasoning, evidence and genre before polishing; preserve the author's supplied facts and meaning, explain consequential changes and provide a complete revised text.
christian-report: Reconcile supplied totals and currencies, distinguish activities from demonstrated outcomes, preserve unknowns and avoid invented counts, accomplishments or commitments.
christian-science: Represent observations, mainstream explanations and the plugin's convictions accurately; distinguish association, causation, models and uncertainty without fabricating empirical support.
christianity-timeline-builder: Verify dates and primary evidence; distinguish composition, reception, institutional decisions and gradual development; label disputed chronology and avoid retrospective simplification.
church-leadership-advisor: Combine fair fact-finding, proportionate protection and governing leadership requirements; distinguish forgiveness, trust, access, fellowship, office and legal responsibilities.
church-media: Preserve only confirmed event facts, fit the channel and audience, and count exactly the requested text region; distinguish estimates from measured duration.
church-program-planner: Match objectives, staffing, sequence, timing and budget to actual resources; identify unconfirmed arrangements without assigning invented commitments to real people.
church-ua-content-publisher: Prepare a complete supported draft payload, validate actual content and preview through available declared tools; preserve consent, existing access and human publication boundaries.
church-ua-integration: Distinguish offline preparation, tool execution, authenticated draft submission, readback and publication; preserve configured origin, existing key scope and retry protections.
debate-argument-auditor: Identify premises, conclusion and inferential steps; test validity and evidential support fairly, distinguish causal claims from association and propose substantive repairs.
deep-exegesis: Trace the passage's argument, context and material grammatical relations; evaluate relevant alternatives fairly and verify any original-language premise before using it.
devotional: Develop a focused reflection from the passage's actual meaning into proportionate encouragement and practical response; avoid invented individual divine promises and preserve requested length.
doctrinal-comparison: Represent each tradition through suitable primary statements and its strongest actual argument before explaining disagreements within the preserved governing framework.
early-christianity-historian: Distinguish manuscript dating, composition, authorship, community context and reception; verify quotations and avoid invented unanimity or unsupported historical continuity.
evangelism: Explain the gospel and relevant passages clearly, listen to the person's actual question, preserve agency and offer a voluntary, practical next step without invented personal revelations.
evangelism-conversation-coach: Prepare natural, respectful exchanges with genuine questions and text-grounded explanations; anticipate real concerns fairly and preserve the listener's voluntary participation.
hebrew-greek-scholar: Verify text and edition, morphology, syntax and suitable lexical evidence; explain contextual meaning rather than transferring every dictionary sense or deriving meaning from resemblance.
interpretation-review: Assess the actual interpretive claim against context, argument and canonical relationships; identify unsupported inferential steps and provide a reasoned substantive revision.
marriage-family-teaching: Preserve governing marriage doctrine while distinguishing forgiveness, trust, protective separation and remarriage; provide safe practical guidance without invented diagnoses or legal conclusions.
master-sermon-writer: Sustain one proclamation through genuine exegesis, coherent development and warranted application; preserve requested length and avoid disconnected outlines or invented illustrative history.
ministry-reports-partner-letters: Reconcile figures, preserve provenance and distinguish attendance, unique participants and demonstrated outcomes; report needs and plans without inventing funding or commitments.
ministry-research-monitor: Compare retrieved evidence against an identified dated baseline; distinguish a new publication from a rediscovered source and an executed search from a proposed schedule.
new-christian-discipleship: Sequence biblical learning, practice and reflection realistically for the learner; use passage-specific questions and understanding checks without promising uniform spiritual outcomes.
pastoral-care: Respond to the actual difficulty with contextual biblical care, concrete proportionate support and agency; distinguish involuntary experiences from choices and avoid diagnosis or repetitive reassurance prescriptions.
pastoral-counseling-assistant: Listen to the stated circumstances, offer biblically grounded practical companionship and suitable help, and avoid invented divine explanations, diagnoses or guaranteed recovery.
personal-biblical-knowledge-base: Preserve source provenance, version history, owner boundaries and storage consent; retrieve actual stored evidence and distinguish proposed records from executed operations.
sermon-red-team: Read the exact manuscript against its original request and sources; identify consequential exegetical, doctrinal, evidential and compositional defects with locations and actionable substantive repairs.
sermon-studio: Develop actual research, manuscript, critique and revision artifacts; bind review to the content reviewed and distinguish genuine separate review from actor labels or unexecuted stages.
sermon: Sustain a coherent proclamation grounded in the anchor passage's argument and governing convictions; develop warranted applications and satisfy the requested audience, length and genre.
sunday-school: Teach the passage through age-appropriate explanation, voluntary activities and an understanding check; reconcile timing and safeguard private disclosures.
textual-criticism: Verify witnesses, dates, readings and editions; distinguish textual evidence from editorial judgment and theological consequence without fabricated sigla or overstated consensus.
trauma-informed-ministry: Prioritize immediate safety, agency and confidentiality appropriate to the facts; separate care from investigation and verify local resources before naming them.
visual-bible-educator: Use accurate source-linked labels and readable visual structure, legends and contrast; distinguish textual design, reconstruction and an actual generated file.
visual-education-studio: Keep source data and interpretation distinct across the visual workflow; verify actual export content and layout and label uncertain reconstructions proportionately.
youth-teaching: Develop the biblical narrative and argument through age-appropriate interactive learning, voluntary participation and understanding checks with realistic timing and no coerced disclosure.
